review: All 12 logical sheets and their visible totals were checked against the public Dubai Holding Real Estate Phase 7 toolkit. Its floor-plan PDF uses older phase labels in the underlying drawing text. Visible totals and release scope follow the officially linked Phase 7 pack. The separate launch presentation uses rounded figures and differs for the 3B1 variant. The public brochure’s location plan highlights Phase 7.
unavailable: The project gate coordinates and individual plot assignment for each layout were not publicly confirmed.
